decisions.rationale: Valid: the first-pass rule messages printed instruction sequences and values, and Phase 1 told learners to read them as the checklist. Fixed in current bytes (reconciler grep of the return strings in tests/lab.mjs for the originally disclosed fragments finds none; the healthcheck messages name the tool the page teaches, not the line): every rule message in tests/lab.mjs (5d983d0d...) names the file and the unmet rule without a template line, tag, ignore entry, URL template or healthcheck line; README Phase 1 and Phase 4 wording matches. The loop-2 and loop-3 messages (host-network ports, glob manifest copy, chained-entry format) are outcome-level too. Latest education recheck (loop 3) is resolved.

Valid: Troubleshooting and the runbook messages disclosed the phase-5 commands. Fixed in current bytes: README.md (09ad1bd3...) Troubleshooting uses the neutral placeholder form some-key: "docker compose <subcommand> <options>" and no runbook answer; the runbook messages describe the need, not the subcommand or flag. Latest education recheck (loop 3) is resolved.

Valid: the runbook parser rejected valid command forms with unhelpful messages and accepted some wrong ones. Fixed in current bytes: tests/lab.mjs now collects options in any position, accepts global Compose options and the long container-run form, and accepts a shell wrapper that prints one variable; it rejects a start that names one service, foreground starts, a missing detach option, a password typed into the command, printing the whole environment, logs with no service and a new container in place of the running one. Reconciler read the option parser and rule returns in tests/lab.mjs (5d983d0d...); both critics' loop-3 probes on a completed copy agree, and the private bypass suite (61 cases) is all caught.

Valid: starter TODO markers pointed at nonexistent README steps. Fixed in current bytes: every starter TODO and fixtures/.env.example now point to 'README phase 3, <file heading>' or 'README phase 5', which exist (checked by grep).

Valid: the learner-facing timing was unlabelled and did not reproduce the model. Fixed in current bytes: README.md Timing says 'Authoring estimate, not a measured learner pilot', splits about 42 minutes on S36 and about 45 on S37 with retry allowances of about 58 and 53, and authoring/evidence/containers-cicd/containers-and-compose/coding-lab-timing.json counts 20 tests and six file groups, with each day's worst case inside the 85-minute guided-lab block and at or under 60 minutes.

Valid: the Goal omitted the env file, and the find-the-cause half of debugging#o1 was claimed without saying where it is practised. Fixed in current bytes: README.md Goal lists creating one local env file; the debugging-with-logs-and-exec topic.json lab reason now says the lab checks the commands without running them and that reading the log to find the cause is practised in the page's terminal simulator.

Valid: chained or piped runbook entries got the wrong rule message. Fixed in current bytes (loop 3, git diff 376b3ea2 f6571e6f): every runbook rule in tests/lab.mjs first returns one format message naming the key when an entry contains ;, &, |, <, >, a backtick or $(...), consistent with the README one-command rule; a plain wrong command still gets its own rule message.

Valid: a whole-source COPY before the dependency step passed both deps rules, the exact mistake image-layers#o2 targets. Fixed in current bytes: backend-deps and frontend-deps in tests/lab.mjs allow only the wrapper files and pom.xml, or the npm manifest files, before the dependency RUN; whole-context and source-folder copies are rejected (SME loop-3 runs on a fresh archive copy). Latest SME recheck (loop 3) is resolved.

Valid: the rules did not enforce the README's image versions or wrapper use. Fixed in current bytes: tests/lab.mjs rejects older Java and Node tags, a JRE build stage, a wrapper RUN without the wrapper files and a bare Maven run, and still accepts common valid variants (SME loop-3 runs).

Valid: run-db-alone accepted publish-all, host networking, a foreground run and a typed password. Fixed in current bytes: tests/lab.mjs rejects each of these, and all-interface publishing in every option form (SME loop-3 runs).

Valid: the baked-secret check read only the first ENV/ARG key on one line. Fixed in current bytes: tests/lab.mjs rejects multi-pair, continuation-line and short-name password ENV lines (SME loop-3 runs).
Valid and the same disclosure as cg-education-containers-002. Fixed in current bytes: README.md Troubleshooting uses a neutral placeholder that is not one of the runbook keys.

Valid: lifecycle and logs rules ignored positional words and switched-off options. Fixed in current bytes: tests/lab.mjs rejects one-service start, name-only ps, chained commands, switched-off options, a plain stop and a foreground up (SME loop-3 runs).

Valid: some valid commands were rejected with misleading messages. Fixed in current bytes: tests/lab.mjs accepts a global file option before the subcommand, the long container-run form, an option with a value before the image, and a shell wrapper that prints one named variable (SME loop-2 and loop-3 runs; the value-option list in tests/lab.mjs now covers the documented run options the critic named). Latest SME item is resolved.

Valid: the down -v rule was stated incompletely against the Compose reference. Fixed in current bytes: README.md Phase 5 and the runbook-lifecycle rule treat anonymous and external volumes as the Compose down reference describes.

Valid: Compose .env conventions were applied to the env file passed to a single-container run. Fixed in current bytes: tests/lab.mjs rejects an interpolated password in that env file for run-db-alone, with a reason (SME loop-3 runs). The exact quoting semantics of that env-file option remain inferred from the Docker reference, not engine-verified, as the SME states.

Valid: deferred-reviewable.json deferred changed bytes, and the solved-run record predated phase 5. Fixed in current bytes, both halves: deferred-reviewable.json is deleted in this branch (git diff main..HEAD), and commit b13681b7 rewrote authoring/evidence/containers-cicd/containers-and-compose/coding-lab-solved-run.json (9fa4b2d0...) as 'solved at 37a5518d by run coverage-gap-final-1794978348'. Reconciler check: it binds all 31 tracked public lab files, every hash matches the current bytes, and no tracked lab file is unbound; it records the starter failing all 20 tests, both private solutions passing 20/20 and 61 of 61 private bypass cases caught, matching the SME's independent loop-3 reproduction. The SME's latest item stays 'open' only because it predates the rewrite; this is a medium, so the gate closes it on this decision.

Valid: the timing model still counted 16 tests and five file groups. Fixed in current bytes: authoring/evidence/containers-cicd/containers-and-compose/coding-lab-timing.json (5c4efdc0...) counts 20 tests and six file groups with re-measured test-run seconds, labelled a model.
Valid and the same stale cross-references as cg-education-containers-004. Fixed in current bytes: starter TODOs and fixtures/.env.example point at README phase and file headings that exist.

Valid: committed bypass-case projects together formed a near-complete reference solution, against the authoring/AGENTS.md never-commit rule and lab-contract section 8. Fixed for this branch in current bytes: commit f7f67605 deletes all 51 case files (D only) and leaves authoring/evidence/containers-cicd/containers-and-compose/coding-lab-bypass/run-bypass.mjs (45c8fae8...) as the only file, taking a private cases directory; the reconciler checked that no commit reachable from any ref contains a runbook case directory. Latest SME recheck (loop 3) is resolved. Residual, escalated to the orchestrator and captain and not decidable in this branch: main's tree (until this branch merges) and history still carry the 15 older case projects 01-15 from earlier merged work, and the unmerged local branches fm/pep-laa-containers and fm/pep-laa-containers-preserved also hold older diagnosis-* case projects. Removing these from history means a history rewrite or force-push on shared refs, a decision above this branch. Recorded as accept, not escalate, because the in-branch fix is complete and an escalate decision would keep the high open by design.

Valid: a glob manifest COPY that can match only the two allowed files was rejected with a false message. Fixed in current bytes: tests/lab.mjs resolves the glob against the frontend folder and accepts it, while a source copy before npm ci is still rejected. The SME's noted residual (a glob with a directory part is matched at the top level only) is contrived and accepted without a further change.

Valid: host network mode on the db service bypassed the 127.0.0.1-only port rule. Fixed in current bytes: compose-ports in tests/lab.mjs rejects host network mode with the same reason runbook-run-env uses (SME loop-3 runs).
